project.title: Riverine metagenome raw sequence reads
project.description: In this study, we assessed the impact of treated wastewater discharge on different riverine microbial communities, with a special focus on its potential influence on the antimicrobial resistome (total content of antimicrobial resistance genes, ARGs). A monitoring network was established, including sampling points upstream and downstream of the wastewater treatment plant (WWTP). This project encompasses surface water, treated effluent (24-hour composite), and biofilm (periphyton) samples from an urban river. Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was employed to elucidate taxonomic composition and ARG pools in these microbial communities. Additionally, metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) were reconstructed to identify potential ARG-hosting organisms
